content: Filter UX: bottom sheet (or full-screen panel for many/complex fields) is the standard mobile pattern, triggered by a button showing active-filter count badge (e.g. 'Filtros (3)'). Applied filters surface as removable chips above the results list (not just inside the sheet) so users see active state without reopening it. Apply and Clear-all buttons live fixed at the sheet's bottom edge. The Apply button should preview the result count before committing (e.g. 'Ver 842 imoveis') so users don't apply into a dead end.
